title: Diff Report (diff_report.json) - Prioritized Differences Between GT and Render
description: Structured list of differences between Ground Truth (spec.json) and rendered design (render_spec.json), anchored to locations in images. Generated by Agent A4 (Judge/Differ). Input to feedback loop.

global_score.description: Overall design quality score (0=terrible, 100=perfect match to GT).

color_fidelity.description: Color matching score (avg ΔE per segment).

diffs.description: Prioritized list of differences (most severe first). Top 1-3 inform next iteration feedback.

location_norm.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalized location in render image (0..1) where difference is most visible.

observed.description: What the render shows (e.g., 'Chevron is 2 studs too wide').

expected.description: What the GT shows (e.g., 'Chevron should be 14 studs wide').

suggested_fix.description: Concrete suggestion for A2 (Designer) in next iteration (e.g., 'Reduce chevron_width by 2 studs in spec and use macaroni R=2 instead of R=3').

metric_value.description: Quantitative measure if applicable (e.g., ΔE for color, pixel count for proportion).

converged.description: True if score >= threshold OR severity-max < stop_severity OR iteration == max_iterations.

model_used.description: Model name used for this judgment (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4.8').
